major_cooldowns.name: Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use as often as possible and try to cram in as many Mangle and Thrash casts as you can during the window while spending Rage on Maul or Raze; it is a large damage boost and also a strong defensive that grants a health increase.

major_cooldowns.name: Berserk
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Talent-gated alternative to Incarnation taken on Berserk builds; use on cooldown to push out maximum Mangle, Thrash, and Maul casts during the window.

major_cooldowns.name: Lunar Beam
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Talent-gated; use on cooldown when Incarnation or Berserk is up or more than 30-60 seconds away, and pop your potion while it is active for a damage and self-heal boost.

major_cooldowns.name: Convoke the Spirits
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Talent-gated burst; use on cooldown while in Bear Form, ideally lined up with Lunar Beam on Lunation builds for a strong damage spike.

major_cooldowns.name: Heart of the Wild
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Talent-gated; weave into Cat Form for a large single-target DoT (Feral Frenzy) damage increase, or use in caster form for the Wild Growth group heal when raid healing is needed.

major_cooldowns.name: Red Moon
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Talent-gated; cast on cooldown as a top-priority button when Mangle is available and Red Moon is not already ticking on the target (spell_id is a best guess for the Boundless Moonlight Red Moon ability and may need verification).

rules.description: Keep Mangle and Thrash on cooldown
rules.action: Cast Mangle and Thrash as often as possible so the rotation flows smoothly and your Rage generation stays high; these short-cooldown buttons are the backbone of Guardian's damage.
Refresh Thrash before the DoT falls off and keep it at 3-5 stacks on your targets at all times to sustain your area damage and Rage income.

rules.description: Maintain Moonfire on the primary target
rules.action: Keep Moonfire applied to your primary target and refresh it with Galactic Guardian procs whenever they are available.

rules.description: Spend Rage on Maul, do not waste it on Ironfur
rules.action: Spend Rage on Maul or Raze offensively and stay above 80 Rage for Harnessed Rage; only press Ironfur when you actually need physical mitigation, since unnecessary Ironfur drains Rage and forces low-value Swipe filler.

rules.description: Opener: DoTs first, then big cooldowns
rules.action: Open by getting Moonfire and Thrash rolling and casting Red Moon and Mangle on cooldown, then fire your major cooldowns and settle into the standard priority.

rules.description: Pair major cooldowns when no uses are lost
rules.action: If you fully understand the encounter, time or hold a cooldown to pair it with another as it comes available, but only when doing so costs you zero cooldown uses; otherwise use everything off cooldown.

rules.description: Use Survival Instincts for danger windows
rules.action: Hold Survival Instincts for the most dangerous damage windows of the encounter rather than pressing it on cooldown, since it is your largest 50% damage reduction on a long timer.

rules.description: Swipe only as a last-resort filler
rules.action: Cast Swipe only when you have nothing else to press; excessive Swipe generates no Rage and signals you are spending Rage inefficiently, costing you DPS.
